roster_cell_edit_before_check.name: roster_cell_edit_before_check
roster_cell_edit_before_check.value: ("roster_cell_edit"."before_kind" is null or "roster_cell_edit"."before_kind" in ('work', 'off', 'break')) and (coalesce("roster_cell_edit"."before_kind" = 'work', false) = ("roster_cell_edit"."before_shift_id" is not null))

roster_cell_edit_after_check.name: roster_cell_edit_after_check
roster_cell_edit_after_check.value: ("roster_cell_edit"."after_kind" is null or "roster_cell_edit"."after_kind" in ('work', 'off', 'break')) and (coalesce("roster_cell_edit"."after_kind" = 'work', false) = ("roster_cell_edit"."after_shift_id" is not null))

work_rule_target_check.name: work_rule_target_check
work_rule_target_check.value:
("work_rule"."scope" = 'global' and "work_rule"."site_id" is null and "work_rule"."location_id" is null)
        or ("work_rule"."scope" = 'site' and "work_rule"."site_id" is not null and "work_rule"."location_id" is null)
        or ("work_rule"."scope" = 'location' and "work_rule"."location_id" is not null and "work_rule"."site_id" is null)
